issue.title: Write the active agent-artifact index row at dispatch launch-accept so the launch-receipt overlay window overlaps index availability
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1aq.10.7.5.7.3 (receipt_live_proof, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3) and routed by the sase-1aq.10.7.5.7 land agent.

Live proof on 2026-09-27 (evidence file:explicit:1b071b131efc527dce16b7a1 §1) showed a fresh Athena->Apollo dispatch became servable ~68s after accept: the active agent-artifact index row lands ~30s+ after launch-accept, and the owner's fleet snapshot rebuild adds up to ~60s. The sase-core index-backed catalog overlay (b57cd21) only covers a 30s launch-receipt window, so the overlay window and index availability barely overlap.

task_type_fields.proposal: Have the owner write (or upsert) the active agent-artifact index row when a dispatch launch is accepted, instead of ~30s later, so the 30s launch-receipt catalog overlay always overlaps index availability and fresh remote rows are servable and exact-stoppable within seconds.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1aq.10.7.5.7 only deploys the settled-receipt contract and proves it live; the proof passed (fresh exact stop at 79s settled), so reducing launch-to-visibility latency is a new improvement, not a defect of the epic.

issue.creation_reason: The exact_ops_receipts overlay proved live but fresh rows become servable only ~68s after accept; closing the gap is an improvement outside the deploy-and-prove epic.
